messages:
Sam (PM): Heads-up: Customer 'Helios' asked to move tenant-prefetch GA up to 6 weeks. They need private HSM support and a 95th <80ms SLA for short prompts. Need a crisp dependency map and a minimal acceptable cut if HSM slips.
Ivy (Eng Runtime): Runtime notes: quant variant validation, KV prefetch warmup, and deterministic latency plumbing. I can run a focused perf sweep in ~7 business days if we get corpora.
Rahul (Infra): HSM path requires credential provisioning, network rules, and a small agent change. Best-case end-to-end is 10 business days after approval. Prewarm slots for Dedicated are doable immediately if product commits numbers.
Tess (Security): HSM mandatory for compliance sign-off. Contingency: customer-managed KMS with enhanced audit + 14-day legal exception. Legal will need a short rationale.
Marta (Eng Platform): For latency stability we should place Helios into a pinned Dedicated pool with prewarmed instances and routing pin. I can add placement + a feature-flag in ~6 working days if we get concurrency targets.
Omar (Solutions): Helios can provide top-300 prefixes and accepts a staged ramp. They require clear rollback to hosted if Dedicated degrades and strict tenant isolation.
Ivy (Eng Runtime): Fallback plan: on failover, put tenant into read-only KV mode and drop local write caching; that prevents cross-tenant leakage. We'll add a canary health gate: fail canary if p99 > 120ms.
runbook-bot: New template tenant-prefetch-canary-v1 created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefetch-canary-v1
Sam (PM): Proposed 4-week cadence: Week1 perf smoke + submit HSM exception (if needed); Week2 infra prewarm + KMS wiring; Week3 platform placement + staging E2E; Week4 5% canary -> ramp. If HSM not approved by end of Week2, canary runs under KMS exception only.
Rahul (Infra): Blockers: HSM credential ETA and confirmation of required prewarm concurrency. Also need firewall rule ticket for HSM endpoint.
Tess (Security): I'll prioritize the review; if we take KMS fallback, I need audit retention and signing policy in 48 hours.
Marta (Eng Platform): Please confirm target concurrency: Helios reported peak 110 concurrent sessions, sustained 40 qps. With that I can size pools and open PR for placement + flag.
Ivy (Eng Runtime): Prewarm plan: feed top prefixes and measure first-token latency. Small script will post prefixes in parallel; fail gate if p99 > 120ms. I'll integrate into pre-canary CI.
Omar (Solutions): I'll collect and share prefix list and sample prompts today.
Sam (PM): Owners recap: perf smoke (Ivy) 7bd; HSM exception/legal (Sam+Tess+Legal) submit today; infra prewarm + HSM wiring (Rahul) ~10bd pending creds; platform placement + flag (Marta) 6bd; canary runbook + rollback (Ivy+Marta+SRE) before staging cutoff.
Sam (PM): Draft launch checklist—please thumbs-up or edit:
[ ] p95 < 70ms and p99 < 120ms on canary;
[ ] Security sign-off or KMS exception with audit + legal approval;
[ ] Autoscale validated to 125 concurrency;
[ ] Rollback validated (KV invalidation + read-only failover);
[ ] Customer acceptance tests passed in staging.
Tess (Security): +1 if KMS fallback includes immutable audit and a documented exception window.
Rahul (Infra): +1; add: infra CPU uplift < 6% under stress test.
Ivy (Eng Runtime): +1. I'll own the rollback steps.
Marta (Eng Platform): +1. I'll open placement PR and link it here.
Sam (PM): Awesome. Quick 15m sync tomorrow 11am PT to triage blockers. I'll create a lightweight issue board and assign tasks. :thumbsup:
